purpose: 1:1 tracker for every installed named CLI filter plus concrete workflow and edge-case proposals; this expands but does not overwrite the 144 grouped capability catalog.
count_policy: 416 named filter views are not 416 unique algorithms or all GUI features. 857 matching cells from one retained comparison are neither features nor a coverage percentage. Configured slots and All aggregates are tracked separately in the CLI inventory.
status_policy: No filter is automatically marked missing/planned/implemented. Individual membership must be measured. Related catalog evidence shows verified slices only and does not transfer acceptance status.

mapping_profiles.policy: Store requested-response and final/rendered-document data independently; preserve all link/resource kinds and all reasons. Do not discard richer observations to imitate a table.

Initial redirect/error rows expose their requested status; final metadata shown in dedicated final-document fields. Add every intermediate redirect URL to compatibility table. Count anchors only in Links-view outlinks; expose IMG/resource metrics separately.
Document indexability and resource indexing eligibility are separate booleans/reasons. PNG/JPEG/PDF can be indexable resources; content type alone is not a noindex directive.
Map localized reference reason names to semantic codes while retaining all underlying reasons and precedence. Cosmetic label match is separate from decision match.
Pixel width, content tokenization, rank, MinHash and score boundaries require recorded algorithm/config/version. Approximate measurements must never masquerade as calibrated reference values.
